title: Lockheed Martin Partners With OpenAI to Improve F-35 Sensors
summary:
The aerospace contractor's most secretive engineering wing is integrating generative AI to resolve mathematical and physics hurdles for aircraft development. Lockheed Martin is collaborating with OpenAI to enhance sensor capabilities for the F-35 fighter jet as part of a push for more advanced technical specifications.

Sarah Hiza, senior vice president of technology at Lockheed Martin, described the project while speaking from the firm's Skunk Works facility. The partnership focuses on applying AI to high-level calculations to accelerate the design and optimization of hardware for the defense giant's premier aircraft.
